name: Nebula Drift
author: Erin Carter
description: A Nebula variation seen edge-on: a deep volumetric emission field of drifting palette-hued gas, threaded by serpentine dark dust lanes and Bok globules that silhouette against the backlight, and laced with thin bright ionization filaments. Two parallaxing depth layers and an off-centre luminous heart give real front-to-back depth.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the gas billow and the parallax between depth layers; 0 holds the cloud almost still.

params.label: Dust lanes
params.effect: Darkness and coverage of the dust lanes and Bok globules silhouetted against the glow; 0 clears them for open gas.

params.label: Filaments
params.effect: Brightness of the thin ionization filaments threading the densest gas.

params.label: Gas scale
params.effect: Overall feature scale of the gas and dust; low spreads into broad banks, high packs in fine turbulent structure.
